input.summary: Build Energy with the safer dead-end and bumper shots, collect the lit 9x teleport, reach Energy Level 10, lock a ball, then use two-ball Multiball to rebuild Energy for the next start.

quickInfo.name: Lit spinners
quickInfo.summary: The lit spinner is the reliable scoring route; the right inlane lights the center spinner when it is unlit.

quickInfo.name: Energy Level
quickInfo.summary: Lit dead ends, drop targets, and the rear target advance the ten-step Energy ladder.

quickInfo.name: Teleport
quickInfo.summary: The staged captive ball selects the active teleport, which collects the current countdown value.

quickInfo.name: 9x countdown
quickInfo.summary: Hit the left-ramp blocker, then make a lit teleport before the countdown ends.

quickInfo.name: Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Energy Level 10 lights one ball lock that starts two-ball play.

quickInfo.name: Play More
quickInfo.summary: The right-side posts can return an outlane ball, but their physical behavior varies by machine.

steps.text: Use a soft plunge. Learn the upper-left-flipper feed and watch which spinner is lit.
Shoot the lit spinner. When the center spinner is unlit, roll through the right inlane to light it, then shoot it from the left flipper.
Use the spinner return and bumper garden to build Energy. Hit the rear standup when the feed reaches it; use a lit dead end only when its return is controlled.
Hit the left-ramp blocker to start the 9x countdown. Shoot the lit teleport before the count expires.
modeNotes: Teleport award: The base award rises with the current Energy Level. The blocker starts a 9x-to-1x countdown that multiplies that award.
Teleport side: The staged captive ball selects the active teleport. Watch the lit insert before you shoot.

steps.text: Reach Energy Level 10. Shoot the lit Lock to start two-ball Multiball.
modeNotes: Multiball qualification: Energy advances from 0 to 10. Level 10 lights Lock. The lock starts two-ball play.

steps.text: During Multiball, continue the safer Energy shots. Energy resets at the start but can rebuild before Multiball ends.
Keep shooting the lit spinners during Multiball. Use rebuilt Energy to shorten the next qualification, and take another 9x teleport only when the blocker and a safe teleport align.

fallback.title: Bumper-garden Energy
fallback.when: Use this when the teleports, drop banks, or left-ramp blocker return the ball dangerously.

steps.text: Feed the bumper garden and collect Energy from the rear target.
Use the safer lit dead end when the ball returns under control.
At Energy Level 10, start Multiball instead of forcing the 9x countdown.
Rebuild Energy during Multiball and repeat the protection route.

alternatives.title: Drop-bank finish
alternatives.when: Use this only when one target remains and the rebound is acceptable.

steps.text: Let incidental hits clear most of a four-target bank.
Shoot the final target to collect its Energy advance.
Return to the dead ends or bumper garden. Do not repeat full-bank attacks from a bad feed.
Score lit dead-end shots, drop targets, and the rear target until Energy reaches Level 10, then shoot the lit Lock to start two-ball Multiball.
Rebuild Energy during Multiball so the next qualification is shorter.
Use the blocker and lit teleport when a controlled 9x collect is available.
Repeat these two engines. TX-Sector has no separate conventional wizard mode.

techniques.name: Soft-plunge upper feed
techniques.instruction: Plunge softly to reach the upper-left flipper. A hard plunge can take a less controlled hop through the top area.

cautions.issue: The drop banks can produce fast lateral rebounds.
cautions.response: Use incidental hits and finish a bank only when one target remains. Prefer the lit dead ends and bumper garden for Energy.

cautions.issue: The right outlane can enter the Play More posts, and a machine shake can affect the return or tilt the game.
cautions.response: Learn the local tilt sensitivity before you depend on the posts. Do not use a large shake in competition.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Energy memory and three-ball or five-ball scoring.
Test soft-plunge feed, teleports, blockers, and dead-end returns.

input.simpleOverview: TX-Sector uses lit dead ends and targets to raise Energy, while the captive ball selects a Teleport collect. Build to Energy Level 10, take the 9x Teleport when lit, lock one ball, then use two-ball play to rebuild Energy for the next start.
